feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
entry.summary: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

entry.title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
entry.summary: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.

entry.title: Fill in the blank in the quiz: Trump's says his triumphal arch will include _____
entry.summary: Plus: It's a very special week! But which one?

entry.title: Years after storms, clean-up crews meticulously separate the sentimental from the wreckage
entry.summary: Across the country, lost-and-found networks seek to reunite objects with disaster survivors. The work can take years. In some cases, it's impossible to pick up all the pieces.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Takeaways from the summit between President Trump and China's Xi, three media outlets banned from the White House returned Thursday after a judge's ruling, Israel's prime minister addresses the U.N.

entry.title: How a hospital custodian with a song became a woman's lifelong friend
entry.summary: For StoryCorps, a hospital custodian and a woman whose mother is a patient cross paths and form a lasting friendship.

entry.title: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, has died
entry.summary: James Copenhaver, one of three campaign rally attendees shot in 2024 during an assassination attempt on then-candidate Donald Trump, has died in Pittsburgh, his lawyer said Thursday. He was 76.

entry.title: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
entry.summary: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

entry.title: FBI investigating after hackers say they took sensitive data from agency's jobs site
entry.summary: The FBI is investigating criminal hackers' claims of breaching its jobs website. The apparent hack poses a potential counterintelligence risk and a safety concern for employees and applicants.

entry.title: The Education Dept. hasn't been dismantled. It's become more inefficient, staff say
entry.summary: Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.
